subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs after the setup guidance is repaired?
rationale: VISION.md routes vendor promotion outside core, while this PR is narrower and vendor-neutral; automation cannot decide the first-party hardware-docs boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Land the guide once NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and commercial hardware references remain omitted.

options.title: Keep Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause the PR and ask contributors to keep Jetson hardware guidance in vendor or ecosystem docs.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Docs
options.body: Ask for a smaller generic ARM/edge-hosting page instead of a Jetson-specific first-party page.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Land the guide once NVIDIA setup guidance is corrected and commercial hardware references remain omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily docs/product scope, and history ties this area to VISION and first-party docs policy.
